title: A simpler account page and smoother signup
summary:
Account and signup friction got trimmed, repeat text requests gained a cache path, and the community directory grew by one assistant.

Enter’s account page now shows a more precise Pollen balance, puts the customer portal and sign-out in the profile menu, and simplifies API key creation by removing the allowed-domains prompt. Key deletion now asks for confirmation. Signup also handles accounts whose customer record already exists.

POST requests to the root of the text API can now return cached responses instead of always reaching the origin, making cache hits faster. Root-path GET requests still bypass the cache.

The community projects directory added @hadadarjt’s J.A.R.V.I.S., a context-aware chat assistant that uses Pollinations for image and audio generation.

highlights.title: A tidier account page
highlights.text: See your Pollen balance at four decimal places, create API keys without an allowed-domains prompt, and find the customer portal in your profile menu. [Open API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
